5232-7874-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5232-7874-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7841-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
6972-7841-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

240-1322-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

512-7014-7287.easyPrerequisites: Transdimensional Bovine and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-7014-7287.description:
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

4419-4659-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4659-4694-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat from step 1.

1315-3234-3293-4247.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-3234-3293-4247.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat
1315-3234-3293-4247.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4247-7084-7201.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

640-1981-2415-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5477-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5477-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

573-5411-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Gruul Turf.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Gruul Turf from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

813-1987-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
813-1987-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
813-1987-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
813-1987-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1636-7370-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-7370-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Kykar triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1850-4693-7705.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 Moloid creature token.
Repeat.
1850-4693-7705.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

338-7173-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-7173-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

500-2081-3191-3908.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Spark Double and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Spark Double dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Spark Double tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-2081-3191-3908.notes: The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

855-1806-2060-2292-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

3165-3532-5078-7052.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-7052.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2440-3581-4359-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-4359-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1545-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1545-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

821-4699-5220-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1878-2713-3454-4539-5496.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
1878-2713-3454-4539-5496.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Unexpected Windfall and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Tomb Trawler twice by paying {2}, putting Unexpected Windfall and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4636-5770-6753.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

276-1371-3432-6500.easyPrerequisites:
There is a land on the battlefield.
Each opponent has 40 or less life.
276-1371-3432-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible, if desired.
276-1371-3432-6500.description:
Give Tephraderm indestructible, if needed.
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Star of Extinction.
Resolve an opponent's Star of Extinction, destroying a land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and planeswalker.
Tephraderm's second ability triggers, dealing 40 damage to the opponent who controlled the Star of Extinction copy due to Angrath's Marauders.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining Star of Extinction until each opponent lose the game.
276-1371-3432-6500.notes: If an opponent survives the loop, you will lose the game if you have 80 or less life once your own Star of Extinction resolves.

880-1659-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-1659-4871.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1323-1606-3995.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Horseshoe Crab and Ley Weaver each have at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1323-1606-3995.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Repeat.
You may tap an additional land each cycle to get infinite mana, and you may then use Experiment Kraj's ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

1295-2503-5229.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Ulamog if it is on the battlefield, or a way to discard it if it is in your hand.
1295-2503-5229.description:
Discard Ulamog if it is in your hand, or kill it if it is on the battlefield.
Ulamog triggers, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
When Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

1349-1999-2793-4050-5089.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1349-1999-2793-4050-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability triggers, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {U}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Ugin's Nexus to your hand, choosing to not put an artifact onto the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

152-1379-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {8}.
152-1379-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Palinchron with haste.
The token Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

1912-3068-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Jenson.
Jenson does not have summoning sickness.
1912-3068-4222.description:
Activate Jenson by paying {3} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untaping Jenson.
Repeat.

1447-1734-2034.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

229-575-4489.description:
Cast Endless One for {X} = 0.
Endless One dies to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Tap that Forest for {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Endless One, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

654-774-2404-3886-4637.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional lands that tap for mana.
654-774-2404-3886-4637.description:
Activate Soratami Mirror-Mage by paying {3} and returning Gaea's Cradle and two other mana-producing lands from the battlefield to your hand, returning Omnath from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Omnath by paying {W}{U}{R}{G}.
Omnath enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Gaea's Cradle and another mana-producing land from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Omnath triggers twice and Amulet of Vigor triggers twice.
Resolve both Omnath triggers, causing you to gain 4 life and add {W}{U}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands that entered the battlefield.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate the additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Patron of the Moon again by paying {1}, putting the third land from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve Omnath's trigger, dealing 4 damage to each opponent and each planeswalker you don't control.
Resolve Amulet of Vigor's trigger, untapping that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
